d.ko: Build a grand totalitarian colony and personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

d.zh: 建立一座伟大的铁律殖民地，然后亲自率领士兵冲入 Roguelite 战场。塑造公民的恐惧、忠诚、羁绊与仇怨。俘虏敌人，将他们改造成真正的信徒。牺牲弱者，供养强者。掌握绝对权力，让所有生命都屈从于你的意志。
